{{Top|leg}}
{{Youmay|warchief|[[War Chief]]}}
A '''warchief''', or '''war chief''', was the military leader of a small organization, usually a primitive village or city.<ref name="SW7">[[Star Wars (1998) 7|''Star Wars'' (1998) 7]]</ref><ref name="SWG:RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>

[[Kerritamba Village]] of the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] had a warchief. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], their warchief was a Wookiee named [[Naloriss]].<ref name="SWG:RotW" /> The [[Lost Aqualish]] also had their warchiefs.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

Other individuals who held the title included the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] leader [[Raikhssa]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="TWOTJ">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Way of the Jedi]]''</ref> and the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Rehkta]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Raid on Rakata Prime]].<ref name="Legacy of the Rakata">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=tactical|Legacy of the Rakata}}</ref>
